dhp383:4:
brāhmaṇa → jinḍi srotaඃ parākrāmya kāmān praṇuda 
brāhmaṇa nāprahāya muniඃ kāmān ekatvamadhigacchati. (udānavarga 10.1)
dhp386:4:
brāhmaṇaṃ → jhayi parakata budhu kitakica anasavu 
budhu daśabaluvetu tamahu bromī bramana. (prā. dha. B . 5)
dhp387:6:
tejasā → diva tavatī adivu rati ahai cadrimu 
sanadhu chatrio tavatī jhai tavati bramano 
adha sarva abhoratra budu tavati teyasa. (prā. dha.)
